lead: The semantic structure and look of a table, with no table library behind it: the caller owns the sorting, selection and pagination state (TanStack Table, server-side pagination or your own code all work), and this component only draws.

resize.title: Resizable Columns
resize.description: The caller owns the column widths: pass `width`, `resizable` and `onResize` to `Head`. Drag the right edge, or focus the handle and use the left / right arrow keys (Shift for a larger step, Home / End for the min / max). The last column has no width and takes the remaining space.

sticky.title: Sticky Header
sticky.description: `stickyHeader` keeps the header in view and scrolls only the rows, inside a themed scrollbar (a `ScrollArea`) that starts below the header and stops at the bottom of the rows. The table takes the height of its parent, which has to have one: a box with a height as here, or a flex column that has one (`Card fill`, `Flex grow`).

expand.title: Expandable Rows
expand.description: The caller owns which rows are expanded. Put a `Table.ExpandButton` in each data row (the `kind="expand"` column) and render a `Table.ExpandedRow` after the row when it is expanded. The same button in the header cell is "expand all / collapse all": it collapses every row when all are expanded, and expands them all otherwise.

editable.title: Editable Cells
editable.description: Inline editing: a cell is a button showing its value; click, Enter or F2 starts editing. Enter or blur commits, Esc cancels, and a value that fails validation stays in edit mode with the error (restored on blur). The caller owns the value; `type` is text, number or select.

api.title: API Reference
api.sections: `Table.Header` / `Table.Body` / `Table.Footer` / `Table.Caption` render `thead` / `tbody` / `tfoot` / `caption` and take their native attributes. The parts with props of their own:

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `table.css`. The default theme style has a light header, short dividers between columns, a light primary background on hover and selection, and sort icons that show on hover.
styling.root: The container handles scrolling and the outer frame; `table` writes `data-size` / `striped` / `hoverable` / `loading`
styling.cells: Row (`data-selected`), header cell (`data-sortable` / `data-sort`), cell (`data-align` / `data-kind` / `data-fixed`; fixed columns get a `--tbl-fixed` offset and the innermost one `data-fixed-edge`; the container gets `data-scroll-x`)
styling.sort: The button, text and icon of a sortable header; the icon's two paths carry `data-part="up"` / `"down"`
